name: NeuralWatt Usage
description: NeuralWatt quota, spend and credit balance in Orca's status bar.

settings.title: API key
settings.description: Entry-only: on the next refresh the key is moved into the encrypted secret store (macOS Keychain) and this field is cleared. Sent only to https://api.neuralwatt.com. To remove the stored key run 'NeuralWatt: Forget stored API key'. Leave empty to borrow the key from OpenCode instead.

settings.title: OpenCode server URL
settings.description: Optional. Used only when no API key is stored: borrows the NeuralWatt credential from a running OpenCode server, from 'opencode auth export', or from OpenCode's legacy auth file — in that order.

settings.title: OpenCode server password
settings.description: Optional. Entry-only: moved into the encrypted secret store and cleared from this field; a ?password= in the server URL is moved too. Leave empty when the server has none.
